headline: AI Chip Demand Surges; Oil Dips on Iran Pause; Fed Rate Decision Looms
summary: US markets saw shifts as AI chip demand intensified, with Nvidia securing key deals and Google exploring Samsung for future TPU production. Oil prices declined over 5% following a pause in US-Iran military strikes, easing geopolitical tensions. The Federal Reserve's upcoming meeting remains a focal point, with economists largely expecting a rate hold despite recent oil price volatility.

bullets.lead: Nvidia has secured a critical HBM supply deal and expanded its AI race footprint.

segments.text: Nvidia has locked down a deal that significantly changes the AI race landscape, ensuring critical HBM memory supply from SK Hynix as part of a $500 billion AI deal.

sources.title: Nvidia just locked down deal that changes AI race

bullets.lead: Google is considering Samsung for partial production of its next-gen AI chips.

segments.text: Google is exploring Samsung Electronics for the production of memory I/O dies for its 10th-gen TPU "Icefish" using 2nm process, while core compute engines would be handled by TSMC's 1.4nm process.

sources.title: How Google Is Using Wall Street Financing Techniques to Expand Chip Sales

segments.text: This move comes as TSMC's production capacity is tightening due to high demand for Nvidia's AI chips, prompting Google to diversify its supply chain.

bullets.lead: TSMC's 3nm process is fully booked through 2027, securing major clients.

segments.text: TSMC's 3nm process is reportedly fully loaded with orders through 2027, including major clients like Qualcomm for Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Tesla for its AI5 chip.

bullets.lead: AMD is producing new processors and GPUs at TSMC using advanced packaging.

segments.text: AMD's new Venice processor and Instinct MI455X GPU are in production at TSMC on 2nm, utilizing CoWoS-L and SoIC advanced packaging.

x_themes.topic: Samsung-Broadcom $200B MOU for foundry, memory, and advanced packaging
x_themes.summary: Samsung Electronics and Broadcom signed a $200 billion MOU for potential cooperation through 2030, encompassing Samsung's 2nm-and-below foundry processes, HBM supply for AI accelerators, and advanced 2.3D/2.5D packaging.

x_themes.topic: Nokia shares fall despite strong AI orders due to conservative outlook
x_themes.summary: Nokia's shares fell despite strong Q2 AI-related order intake of €2.8 billion, as analysts expressed disappointment over the company's unchanged growth outlook for its IP and optical network segments.

x_themes.topic: Accelerating AI optical demand and multi-year procurement
x_themes.summary: Nokia's Q2 results indicate AI infrastructure spending is broadening into optical transport, with AI and Cloud sales up 105% and multi-year procurement for leading-edge optical products.

x_themes.topic: Memory pricing power extending to networking equipment
x_themes.summary: Nokia identified memory as a significant supply-chain risk due to constrained availability and substantial price increases, impacting high-end routers, switches, optical systems, and network appliances.
